For more than three decades, Pine Straw Distributors LLC has supplied high-quality,
all-natural pine straw to landscapers, golf courses, nurseries, contractors, and
retailers across the United States. Based in Florida and led by industry expert
Lori Wiederstein, we specialize in longleaf and slash pine straw sourced from the
premium forests of North Florida and South Georgia.

We are a trusted national distributor known for reliability, consistency, and
exceptional customer service.

## Our Products

### Longleaf Pine Straw

- Longer needles for a premium, high-end look
- Excellent for erosion control
- Popular for high-end commercial and residential properties, golf courses, and retail resale

### Slash Pine Straw

- Great for large-scale landscaping and cost-efficient coverage
- Excellent for erosion control
- Popular with contractors and municipalities

## Truckload Options

We offer two wholesale shipping formats to meet your operational needs:

### Palletized Pine Straw

- 1,344 bales per truckload
- Easy to unload
- Ideal for retail garden centers, nurseries, and organized storage

### Floor-Loaded Pine Straw

- 1,540 bales per truckload
- Half truckloads are available
- Best for high-volume landscapers and distributors

Nationwide delivery is available. Our logistics team coordinates every detail to
ensure timely, reliable shipments.
